title: Tenant provisioning API
description:
What: one call creates a tenant with default config, brand pack, starter pages and subdomain; idempotent with a replay key. Registers the site as an Account entitlement in Prospectus (see PPY-a1e75a for the waiting contract).
Acceptance:
Scenario: A replayed create returns the same tenant
  Given a create call with a replay key
  When it is sent twice
  Then one tenant exists

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented by PPY-70a429 with PPY-3aa10f. Plan note: a tenant is a site owned by a Prospectus Account (one Account may own several sites), not the Account itself; lib/tenant-keys.ts tenantIdForProspectusAccount currently maps tenant = account and changes in PPY-0bb0fd (owner decision 1 in the design note).
